messages:
sophie: quick: we had an auto-fallback flip on /api/chat for ~22s this morning. short 502 burst, but it went to hard-degrade and paged on-call. noisy. :grimacing:

mike: ouch. which policy fired? any breakdown in the audit row?

sophie: audit row currently says `reason=combined_signal`. painful to debug. the decision service returned no contributors.

arjun: we need a flat, compact decision blob. suggest semicolon-delimited string only: `policy=auto_v2;decision=hard_degrade;score=0.88;top=5xx:0.7,kv_miss:0.12;hint=hysteresis=34s`. no nested JSON so console parses it trivially.

zara: +1 on flat blob. add a short `why` human line too: `why=502 spike + cache misses` so on-call can scan quickly.

mike: also: add a spike_guard and min-duration. proposal: require either duration>=40s OR rolling_avg(30s)>threshold. single-window spikes below 25% severity ignored.

arjun: for audit sampling: only store ids + flat blob in primary audit. full payloads go to sampled-store for degraded requests at 1% by default; on-call can request a 10m elevated token to fetch more. TTL 7d.

sophie: inbox UX: bundle degrade events per-route into a single thread with counts + timeline and include the flat blob in the header. one-click actions: Snooze (5/30/60m), Mark benign, Escalate. Snooze should write `annot=snooze;by=USER;dur=30m` into audit.

zara: safety: add oscillation detector that increases hysteresis when flips >3 in 10m and expose `oscillation_count` in the blob.

notif-bot: deploy scheduled: decision-blob-flat + spike_guard -> canary 4% at 16:40 UTC :rocket:

arjun: action items: arjun -> spec blob examples and oscillation field; mike -> PR for spike_guard and min-duration; zara -> inbox bundling mock + annotation behaviour; sophie -> short runbook snippet for on-call.
